title: linaria genistifolia var. parviflora
intro: Linaria genistifolia var. parviflora, commonly known as Toadflax or Small-flowered Toadflax, is a flowering plant in the figwort family (Scrophulariaceae) that is native to Europe and Western Asia. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Linaria genistifolia var. parviflora include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit sedative and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
